card.name: Inside potassium and electrolyte terms
card.fires_on: The middle piece of 'hypokalemia' or 'normokalemia' (the 'alem' part), and once 'electrolytes' split after 'electroly'. Seen in QT-prolongation and potassium warnings.

modes.label: Inside hypokalemia
modes.description: The 'alem' piece in hypokalemia or normokalemia, often next to hypomagnesemia.

modes.label: Inside electrolytes
modes.description: The split of 'electrolytes' in an instruction to monitor or correct them.
modes.example: Monitor<< electroly>>tes before and during treatment.

card.writes: It helps the model finish the rest of the word (such as 'ia' or 'tes'); the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated.
card.plain: It fires partway through the words hypokalemia and electrolytes, mostly in heart-rhythm warnings about low potassium.
